title: Generalized Star Height at Most Four
summary: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has generalized star height at most four over that same alphabet. We give a complete construction using an affine correction that hides one interval product, a finite clock, and several scales for moving boundaries through periodic words.
family_title: Generalized star height at most three

review.reason: Proves every regular language has generalized star height at most four, with a construction.
